decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	With appropriate safeguarding conditions the erection of boundary fencing along the site boundary would be acceptable, having a positive impact on the appearance of the area and improving safety and security of the site. The development is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.5 (Development affecting the setting of a listed building) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Not withstanding the approved drawing 5764 - 02C further details showing a revised design and type of fencing fronting Church Road in front of the Old Rectory Nursery shall be submitted for approval by the Local Planning Authority prior to any commencement of work and the deatils so approved shall be implemented at the same time as the rest of the fencing.
description: Erection of perimeter fencing with assciated landscaping
